purpose: Descriptive split inspection for the oral-exam handoff; supplements the frozen experiment without rerunning or changing it.

definitions.training_items: Union of every users train_items, excluding val_item and test_item.
definitions.catalog: Union of all train_items, val_item and test_item.
definitions.retained_events_per_user: len(train_items) + 2, before the latest-20 input truncation.
definitions.test_target_absence: Count users whose test_item is absent from the global training-item union; not a separately evaluated cold-start experiment.
